uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more phyresis counters on it

1339-3394-3899.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-3394-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

728-5254-8122.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
You don't control an Army, or the only Army you do control is the creature with power 4 or greater.
728-5254-8122.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature with power 4 or greater. If you control an Army, ensure to sacrifice that creature.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.
728-5254-8122.notes: The Orc Army will become a 5/5 due to the counters and the buff provided by The Muckslinger Gang.

1424-2060-4687.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least four counters on it.
1424-2060-4687.description:
Activate Presence of Gond by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Crystalline Crawler, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

2353-4691-5796.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2353-4691-5796.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
2353-4691-5796.description:
Draw a card.
When you draw a card, Niv-Mizzet and Starving Revenant's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Starving Revenant ability, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Niv-Mizzet ability, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
When you lose life, Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1086-1981-2415-3967.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1086-1981-2415-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

277-2557-4094-4772-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-2557-4094-4772-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

2459-3558-6516-7735.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
2459-3558-6516-7735.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

3490-4050-4268-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-4268-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heroic Feast trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1308-1563-2457-5434.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

206-2440-2703.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat using the Myr Propagator token instead.

333-2281-5256.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Shepherd of the Cosmos
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Saffi triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

911-6797-6972--112.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Propeller Pioneer.
When Propeller Pioneer dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Propeller Pioneer enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.
911-6797-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Propeller Pioneer's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

1894-5220-6094-6900.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1482-2854-4574-5243.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1482-2854-4574-5243.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2173-4905-5220-5931.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Funeral Room // Awakening Hall trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Funeral Room // Awakening Hall trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

225-539-872-1671.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Scaled Herbalist as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

2530-2577-5870-6518.easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
2530-2577-5870-6518.description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

1872-4979-5856.description:
Activate a Food using Gilded Goose's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, creating a Food token.
Activate the Food tapped in step 1 using Composite Golem's ability by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.

1656-2084.description: Activate Necrotic Ooze using Mirror-Mad Phantasm's ability by paying {1}{U}, causing you to shuffle Necrotic Ooze into your library and mill all cards from your library.

1737-3621-4853-5231.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {8} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {R}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi Cave Guard trigger, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

2043-4772-6252.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Boommobile that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
When the Boommobile tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
2043-4772-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1617-4831-4983-5241-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Sakashima's Student on the battlefield as a copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
1617-4831-4983-5241-5358.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger twice.
Resolve both Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having Cacophodon fight Bellowing Aegisaur and Sakashima's Student to ensure neither dies due to lethal damage.

618-2292-3991.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token.
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

708-2459-2500-2511.description:
Pay {2} to Mirage Mirror to have it become a copy of Myth Unbound until end of turn.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Rograkh, returning Rograkh to the command zone.
When Rograkh enters the command zone, both copies of Myth Unbound trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 2.

1707-3356-3899.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1707-3356-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Last Laugh's first ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Polyraptor triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat, sacrificing the damaged Polyraptor instead.

186-411-944-4720.description:
Pay {R} to return Grinning Ignus to your hand, adding {R}{C}{C}.
Cast Grinning Ignus for {R}.
Activate Stonework Packbeast for {C} to add {R} leaving you where you started with with an additional {1}.
Repeat for infinite mana.
